Section1.title: You just focus on content production and supply!

Features.title: Features
Features.text1: Customer information such as mobile number and email is automatically saved in their profile.
Features.text2: Don't worry about Instagram access limits, your customer data is transferred from Instagram to your private database and if your page is deleted for any reason, you still have access to your customers.
Features.text3: Don't worry about losing customer messages, payment issues, and order registration, customers can easily start and register their orders without needing to sign up.
Features.text4: After registering the order, the purchase information is automatically sent to the post office and a postal receipt is issued.
Features.text5: Respond to customers more intelligently and build message automations for more customer purchases.
Features.text6: Communicate with customers through various channels such as direct messages, automation, SMS, etc.

BigSection.description2: Customize your workflow and increase productivity.

faq.q1: Is it possible to upgrade the subscription after payment?
faq.a1: Yes, you can upgrade your subscription at any time and if you upgrade, half of the current subscription time will be added to the higher subscription.
faq.q2: If the subscription is not renewed, the scheduling content will be published?
faq.a2: At the time of the subscription, your account will stop and the new hubs will be disabled for you.
faq.q3: Why WhatsApp and some social networks do not exist?
faq.a3: It is not possible to add all of them on all social networks due to the limitations on the API or the lack of channels and pages.
faq.q4: If not used, will the subscription time be kept?
faq.a4: No, after activating and starting your subscription time if you use or not use, your subscription time will be automatically reduced.
